The [Exploratory and Descriptive Methods](exploratory-descriptive.qmd)
page defines the sample statistics used on this page,
each with an example:

- the [sample mean](exploratory-descriptive.qmd#def-sample-mean);
- the [sample median](exploratory-descriptive.qmd#def-sample-median);
- the [sample variance](exploratory-descriptive.qmd#def-sample-variance);
- the [sample standard deviation](exploratory-descriptive.qmd#def-sample-sd);
- the [interquartile range](exploratory-descriptive.qmd#def-IQR);
- the [sample proportion](exploratory-descriptive.qmd#def-sample-proportion).

That page also defines the graphs used here,
including [box plots](exploratory-descriptive.qmd#def-boxplot)
and [scatter plots](exploratory-descriptive.qmd#def-scatterplot).
